# Reese W. Hollister — reesehollister.com

Reese W. Hollister is a historian of North Africa, AI-fluent educator, and workflow designer based in Bucks County, Pennsylvania.

## Core identity

- Historian specializing in North Africa, postcolonial institutions, and civil aviation history
- Fulbright Scholar, Morocco 2023–24
- Master of International Studies, NC State University (2026, 4.0 GPA)
- CRLA Level III writing consultant, NC State Academic Success Center
- Co-founder of Huruf La'b, a tactile Arabic learning startup (VenturePack winner, $4,000, April 2026)

## Applied AI work

Reese designs and documents AI-assisted workflows for research, teaching, and public communication. Key workflows:

- Writing center triage workflow: AI-assisted classification, tutor-prep questions, and reusable revision checklists; human tutor makes all judgment calls
- Huruf La'b teacher support system: AI-generated Arabic practice sequences, misconception lists, and lesson variants; teacher selects and adapts
- Historical research-to-script pipeline: source organization, outline generation, and pacing revision; all historical claims verified by human
- African airlines data extraction workflow: structured dataset from fragmentary sources; human defines variables and checks every ambiguous entry

He operates from a 4D framework: Delegation, Description, Discernment, and Diligence.

## Research

- Postcolonial African civil aviation: From Colonies to Carriers — 723-airline dataset, Royal Air Maroc case study
- Western Sahara infrastructure and sovereignty: roads-over-time workflow using OSM and ohsome data
- Morocco transitional justice: Truth After Tazmamart and the Equity and Reconciliation Commission
- Fulbright Morocco fieldwork: archival research at Al-Akhawayn University, Arabic study, teaching

## Teaching

- Graduate writing consultant and TA at NC State
- History teacher and BrainLyne convenor at the American Language Center, Rabat
- Arabic language instruction connected to Huruf La'b; CRLA Level III certified
